## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen solution, and any public API or compatibility impact.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated deterministic tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I ran the Release build, Testcontainers/PostgreSQL tests, and formatting check.
- [ ] Transaction, cancellation, identifier quoting, SQL construction, and row/secret logging were reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] Public API XML docs and relevant README, usage, security, and changelog documentation are updated.
- [ ] Performance claims or hot-path changes include reproducible benchmark evidence.
- [ ] Dependency changes include affected lock files; workflow actions remain pinned to full commit SHAs.
- [ ] This change contains no credentials, connection strings, production row data, generated build output, or unrelated edits.

## References

Link the issue, upstream EF Core/Npgsql/PostgreSQL contract, benchmark, or advisory used to validate the change.
